what_happened: The Claude CLI began reporting status "allowed_warning" with utilization 0.90 on the five-hour window resetting 2026-09-17T08:30:00Z. Both of the coordinator rule triggers were breached (status != allowed; utilization >= 0.80). Admissions were stopped on both live arms; no worker was cancelled and every live job was left to finish and receipt normally.

schema_correction.earlier_claim: An earlier note in this bundle said no utilization field exists in rate_limit_event.
schema_correction.correction: That was true of the 40 all-"allowed" records seen at the time but WRONG as a general claim. The payload schema is CONDITIONAL on status: an "allowed" record carries overageStatus and overageDisabledReason and no utilization; an "allowed_warning" record carries utilization (0..1) and usually surpassedThreshold, and drops the overage fields. Utilization is reported only once a threshold is passed, which is why it was invisible while the account was healthy.
schema_correction.consequence_for_resume: Below the warning threshold the CLI reports NO utilization at all, so "utilization under 50%" cannot be positively confirmed after the reset: an absent field is consistent with any value below the warning threshold, not specifically below 0.5. No claim of <50% is made from an absent field.

sentinel_defect.what: The sentinel matched live arms on the campaign DIRECTORY rather than the arm. For arm-h2 it returned the already-terminal h2-research alongside h2-review; for arm-s it matched nothing at all. So s-full - the arm whose own jobs produced the warning - was left running and admitting while the sentinel recorded ok:true.
sentinel_defect.why_it_matters: A stop that reports success while the offending arm keeps running is worse than no stop.
sentinel_defect.detected_by: Reading the drained-arm list in the sentinel record against the set of runs without a campaign-terminal.json.
sentinel_defect.remediation: s-full drained by hand at 05:44Z. The sentinel now resolves the arm from each run's own run.json and liveness from whether that run has written campaign-terminal.json - the same durable evidence the campaign uses - instead of a path substring; drains are idempotent; the utilization >= 0.80 trigger was added. Verified live: the restarted sentinel resolved arm-s/s-full and arm-h2/h2-review correctly and reported "already drained; left alone" for both.

drain_mechanism: The durable Meter cap_usd was lowered to each arm's committed total, so every further reservation fails with captured_plus_live_cap and the campaign ends on the designed Stop(insufficient_priced_usage_headroom) once its last live job finishes. The allowance gate was deliberately NOT used: it raises at the top of the scheduler loop and cancels live workers. No captured figure was altered; each meter records the original cap, the committed total, the live jobs left running, the reason and the typed evidence under cap_reductions.
